description: This file defines a migration class GoteoChannelComponents used for database schema changes, including creating and dropping multiple tables related to nodes, sponsors, stories, resources, projects, and workshops, as well as altering existing tables.

classes.name: GoteoChannelComponents
classes.description: A class responsible for database migration operations, including creating and dropping tables and modifying table schemas for various node-related entities.

methods.description: Placeholder method for post-migration tasks after rolling back the migration.

methods.name: getUpSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to perform the database schema changes for migrating 'up', including creating tables and adding columns.

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to reverse the migration, including dropping tables and columns.
